description: Chronos tenant-scoped pipeline runner. Entered ONLY in the child process chronos spawns for a schedule discovered under knowledge/confidential/{tenant}/pipelines/ (and, in the daemon, synchronously while listing/reading that tenant's pipeline files), always bound to that tenant (KYBERION_TENANT / execution-scope tenant, KYBERION_TENANT_SCOPE_REQUIRED=1 in the child). Grants resolve through ${KYBERION_TENANT}, so reads are limited to the bound tenant's confidential root plus the tenant registry; knowledge landings go through ingest:commit (ingest_commit role); writes are limited to that tenant's audit/trace mirrors.
